tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lce btsun chen po bi ma la'i zab tig gi nye brgyud skong ba dad pa'i gdung dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru bidyā dha ra ye/ 'dir rig 'dzin brgyud bskang bya bar 'dod pa dag gis/ tshogs rdzas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas lan gsum spel la/ dbyangs snyan pos/ hūm̐ hrīḥ kun bzang gdod nas rnam dag spros dang bral/ /kun la ye nas rtag khyab tshul gyis brdal/ /kun byed sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i spyi dpal che/ /kun bzang rdo rje sems pa'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dga' chen mi 'gyur ye shes lnga yi bdag /dga' mchog kha sbyor bdun la dgyes rol zhing*/ /dga' ba'i mtshan dper nges gsang ston pa'i tshul/ /dga' rab rdo rje rtsal gyi thugs dam bskang*/ /mtshan nyid chos kyi sgrau 'dogs yongs bcad de/ /mtshan ma'i rtog pa gdod ma'i dbyings su dengs/ /mtshan tsam thos pas the tshom drwa ba gcod/ /mtshan ldan 'jam dpal bshes gnyen thugs dam bskang*/ /rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs pa pha mthar son/ /rig 'dzin gsang lam 'od gsal rdzogs chen don/ /rig pas phral te lam bzang srol 'byed pa/ /rig 'dzin shrī seng ha'i thugs dam bskang*/ /rang 'khrul rtog tshogs 'od gsal dbyings su dag /rang snang mtshan 'dzin sku dang thig ler smin/ /rang bzhin chos kun sku gsum 'bras bur rdzogs/ /rang grol dri med bshes gnyen thugs dam bskang*/ /gsang chen theg rtse 'od gsal snying po'i don/ /gsang tshul bgrang bya bdun du nyams bzhes tshe/ /gsang lam snang bzhi mthar phyin 'ja' skur grub/ /gsang bdag siṃ he shwa ra'i thugs dam bskang*/ /'od gsal bde ba chen po'i sgyu 'phrul gar/ /'od gsal dbyings las dgongs pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs/ /'od gsal snying po gsal byed 'khor los sgyur/ /'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang*/ /bka' bzhin bsgrub pas phan bde lag rtser sbyin/ /bka' gsang gnyan po'i smin grol bdud rtsi yis/

/bka' babs skal ldan 'gro ba rjes su 'dzin/ /bka' drin 'khor med bla ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /mdor na dus gsum gshegs bzhugs 'byon gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas byang sems rtsa gsum dam can dang*/ /'khor 'das mnyam nyid mgron rigs thams cad kyi/ /thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas mchod pa ni/ /mchod yon me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo rol pa'i lha mo bcas/ /'dod yon phyi yi mchod pas thugs dam bskang*/ /rang byung nang gi mchod pas thugs dam bskang*/ /sbyor sgrol gsang ba'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang*/ /bde chen phyag rgya'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang*/ /zung 'jug bla med mchod pas thugs dam bskang*/ /bskang du med de ye grol chen por bskang*/ /sbyor du med de zung 'jug chen por sbyor/ /bsgral du med de mnyam nyid dbyings su sgrol/ /ye bskang ye sbyor ye sgrol chen por bskang*/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /aḥ de ltar 'khor gsum mtshan ma'i rtog tshogs kun/ /rang byung rang snang rang shar rang grol du/ /'od gsal 'dus ma ye byas brjod bral dbyings/ /'ub chub blo 'das chen por e ma ho/ /tshig snyan 'ja' ris bkra min kyang*/ /don bzang rig 'dzin brgyud pa la/ /dad pa'i shugs kyis nyer drangs pas/ /'di la nongs pa med do snyam/ /lhag bsam 'od dkar bdud rtsi'i zil dwangar ky-is/ /yid can ltung ba'i dri tshogs yongs sbyangs te/ /'gro rgyud 'da' dka'i sman mchog bzang pos gtams/ /duḥkha'i gcong nad drung nas 'byin gyur cig /ces dad mos kyi sgo nas nye brgyud kyi don bskang 'di nyid rig 'dzin sna tshogs rang grol du 'bod pa'i gdol spyod pa des shar mar bris pas dus gsum rig 'dzin rgya mtshos rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig ༈ //gsang ba don phrin gyi skong bshags mkha' 'gro'i thol glu bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru ye/ nges don 'od gsal bi ma'i zab tig srol/

/slar yang gsal byed sprul pa'i rol gar can/ /brgyud ldan rdo rje rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro mar/ /'dud do grub gnyis shis pa stsol mdzod kye/ /'dir gsang ba don phrin gyi bskang bshags spro na/ mchod rdzas nam mkha' mdzod ky-i sngags rgyas spel te/ aḥ chos nyid dri med ka dag dbyings/ /dgongs klong 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang*/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor bla na med/ /dgongs brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /nges gsang zab tig bdud rtsi'i thig /bkral sdud snang mdzad gdams pa'i mdzod/ /rtogs grol dus mnyam rig pa 'dzin/ /brda brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /rig 'dzin gsang lam rmad po che/ /mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs thol le ba/ /phul byung gdams pa'i bcud mnga' ba'i/ /snyan brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /mdo sngags rgyud sde'i mdzod mnga' zhing*/ /'od gsal snying po'i shing rta che/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /rgyud bzhi sde gsum theg pa yi/ /dngos grub rgya mtsho'i dpal mnga' ba/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol gar can/ /yi dam lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i gnas yul bdag /bsgrub pa'i drod nyul legs nyes mkhan/ /bar chad sel ba'i g.yar dam can/ /ma tshogs mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*/ /chos bzhin bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /mos pa rnam bzhi'i phrin las can/ /snying po'i drod 'dzin tha tshig gnyan/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang*/ /a: ye bskang ye sbyor ye sgrol bde chen ngang*/ /phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang bla med ky-i/ /rab 'byams zag med mchod sprin rgya mtshos bskang*/ /las bzhi lhun grub don gnyis dngos grub stsol/ /gzung 'dzin sgrib tshogs ka dag dbyings su bshags/ /dmigs med don gyi tshangs pa bstsal du gsol/ /yi ge brgya pa brjod/ zhes gter chen rdo rje 'chang gi zhal snga nas/ nyer mkho'i ched du 'di ltar gyis shigs zhes pa'i bka' stsal spyi bor mchod de/
bag med lhod po sna tshogs rang grol bas dben ri dung dkar sgang gi ri ngogs su bris pa dge'o/ /dge'o/ dge'o// // PAGE PAGE 4 FILENAME S-15.doc
